ABS Non-Conformity : Requirements:
10.1 The Company should establish procedures to ensure that the ship is maintained in conformity with the provisions of the relevant rules and regulations and with any additional requirements, which may be established by the Company.
Evidence:
A Multi-Cable Transit (MCT) located beside the weathertight door, entrance from Fore Winch Deck to Bosun Store, was found not sealed.
Nature:
The unsealed MCT was not checked out by the ship’s crew, resulting in invalid maintenance/ inspection.

ABS Non-Conformity : Requirement:
As per Safety and Environmental Management Manual/ PR-1002/ Sec. 5.1, the ship's crew shall maintain and test critical machinery and equipment to ensure that the indicated daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, two-year, five-year, and ten-year actions are taken for the specified equipment if provided.
Quarterly: means an event should be conducted at least once every 3 months; in all cases the interval between any two consecutive events should not exceed 90 days. (PR-1002/ Sec. 3)
Evidence: 
While sampling the VIMS records for the maintenance and testing of critical machinery and equipment, it was noted that the quarterly testing of the Cargo Hold Fire Damper was carried out on 29-APR-2026, 08-FEB-2026, 13-OCT-2025, and 13-AUG-2025. The interval between the consecutive tests conducted on 13-OCT-2025 and 08-FEB-2026 exceeded the required 90-day interval.
Nature of NC: 
Based on the evidence gathered, maintenance and testing of critical machinery and equipment were not carried out at the intervals specified in the Safety and Environmental Management Manual; therefore, this was categorized as a nonconformity.
Class - Prop. Shaft Survey once every 15 years
